system.description:
As an Instant action on your turn or as a Reaction to successfully dodging an attack, you may choose to move a number of yards equal to your Arcane Might in an instant and should you be in a bout at the end of the movement you may select the combat length of the bout up to a minimum distance of Short.

You may also use this ability as a Reaction to another creature of equal or lesser Arcane Might to yours attempting an ability that changed the Combat Length with supernatural speed such as this one. Make a contested Taijutsu roll against their ability roll and on a success you may deny them the ability to change the Combat Length. Creatures with Arcane Might less than yours automatically fail their roll against you.
